target_customer: Data engineering teams that run pipelines and deliver data products
problem: Data bugs reach consumers because business logic, input data and infrastructure change without monitoring of data quality metrics.
business_model: B2B SaaS data quality monitoring platform with an agent

founders.name: Aaditya Talwai
founders.background_notes: YC page lists about 10 years in DevOps and developer infrastructure. The page has a Former Founders heading but shows only him.

competitors.name: Monte Carlo
competitors.funding_then: 25M Series B in February 2021, then 60M Series C in August 2021

technical_complexity.rationale: Extracting and storing metrics from raw event data and delivered datasets across batch and streaming pipelines is standard infrastructure engineering with hard scaling parts, led by an ex Datadog architect.

defensibility.rationale: Metric definitions and agents deployed in customer pipelines add some lock in, but well funded rivals offered similar monitoring.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Funded observability vendors raised large rounds in 2021 and 2022; no source ties this to Lariat.

market_need_then: Data observability was attracting large venture rounds in 2021, shown by Monte Carlo's Series B and C. No Lariat customer evidence was found beyond a 2024 GetApp review.

branding.domain_note: Site is lariatdata.com; a search snippet also mentioned lariat.co, not opened.

identity.voice_and_tone: Pitch line: discover data bugs before your consumers do.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community found. Lariat is also the name of unrelated software products listed on Capterra and GetApp.

outcome_analysis: Lariat Data was a three person Summer 2021 data quality monitoring startup led by an ex Datadog architect that raised a small pre-seed of about 1.3 million dollars. YC marks it Inactive and the product still appeared on review sites in 2024, but no shutdown or acquisition notice was found, so the cause is not public and no failure factors are assigned. It competed in a category where Monte Carlo raised 25 million and then 60 million dollars within months of the batch.
notes: The pre-seed rests on aggregators only (VCBacked, Bouncewatch, Employbl and an extruct listing); CB Insights shows 130K over 2 rounds, likely a figure error. Investors 468 Capital and Hike Ventures come from the same aggregators. lariatdata.com returned an empty page on fetch, so site status is unknown. CB Insights comparison pages show an ambiguous Acquired label that I could not tie to Lariat. Monte Carlo is a single competitor from a source dated February 2021; Series C August 2021 from TechTarget search results.
